Chapter 978  Chapter 31: Total Suppression (Subscribe Please)_2

Dozens of Yu Clan Ultimate Level Twelves looked puzzled as they sensed the dozens of figures surrounding them, all of which were avatars conjured by the Galaxy Master.

Conjuring avatars is a common technique. Not to mention Ultimate Level Twelves, even powerful beings of Ninth or Tenth Levels can easily do it.

However, the strength of an avatar is far inferior to that of the true body. An avatar of a Level Eleven powerhouse is estimated to be weaker than even the Ninth or Tenth Level powerhouses.

In the past, the avatars conjured by Ultimate Level Twelves were mainly used to bully those special life forms, the Ancient Gods at Level Eleven Perfect. As for beings at the same level? Avatars were ultimately too weak.

Even at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, the avatars Lin Yuan could conjure wouldn't be too strong, only slightly more powerful than Level Eleven Perfect beings.

What about such avatars? Let alone dozens, what about hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands?

"What does the Galaxy Master want to do?"

"Conjure dozens of avatars?"

"Does he really think that these dozens of avatars can deal with us?"

"Does the Galaxy Master see us as those Level Eleven beings?"

The many Ultimate Level Twelves within the grand palace communicated with each other.

Everyone was well aware of the power disparity between an avatar and the true owner of the body.

Even though they considered themselves no match for the Galaxy Master, they couldn't believe a mere avatar could handle them?

"Still, we'd better be careful."

The Yu Clan Ultimate controlling the grand palace was puzzled too, but was not the least bit careless, remaining alert and putting forth their best effort.

"Dozens of avatars?"

In the territory of the Robber Clan, two of the Robber Clan Ultimates were also somewhat perplexed.

However.

The next moment.

Under the watchful eyes of all the Ultimate Level Twelves, the dozens of avatars surrounding the grand palace attacked simultaneously.

In an instant, vast expanses of space-time began to collapse and implode, and the defensive secret treasure of the Path Splitting Realm peak that protected all the Ultimate Level Twelves - the grand palace - appeared like a lonely boat floating on the ocean surface, on the verge of destruction at any moment.

"This?"

"This is impossible?"

"Merely avatars, yet they possess such formidable power?"

All the Ultimate Level Twelves inside the palace were a bit dazed, feeling the tremors of the palace. This peak Path Splitting Realm defensive secret treasure was being crushed by a terrifying force near or beyond its limits.

Lin Yuan silently watched the grand palace rolling and trembling continuously.

The upper limit of combat strength in the Main Universe is fixed at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm, which is an ironclad rule, unless one possesses the power to contend with the Main Universe; otherwise, they are subject to suppression.

And to contend with a universe? The universe itself is akin to the size of a normal Chaos Venerable, which results in normal Chaos Venerables being suppressed within a universe.

Of course, if one were a Chaos Great Saint, it would not be so. Although a Chaos Great Saint cannot completely erase a universe, they can destroy its Origin Source, propelling it towards premature annihilation.

...

Lin Yuan is no exception.

Though after stepping into Level Twelve, Lin Yuan's combat strength directly reached the level of a sovereign, within the universe, his ability to exert limit-strength is that of the peak Path Splitting Realm.

But even at the peak Path Splitting Realm strength, Lin Yuan is much stronger than a normal Path Splitting Realm peak.

The most apparent evidence is that the avatars Lin Yuan conjured possess nearly the strength of Path Splitting Realm peak.

The universe limits the maximum combat strength to the peak of the Path Splitting Realm but doesn't restrict the number of beings at the maximum strength level.

"Pity, the efficiency is still too slow."

Lin Yuan shook his head inwardly. Without the universe's suppression, using his strength to deal with these Ultimate Level Twelves would not be so troublesome.

He could directly invoke the Mind Will Secret Skills—Abyssal Eye.

With Lin Yuan's current mind will index of sixty million, once he deploys the "Abyssal Eye," the consciousness of these Level Twelve Path Splitting Realm beings would all sink into oblivion.

The disparity in mind will index is too great.

"I'll make do for now."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, carefully observing the grand palace.

"Space-time..."

As Lin Yuan's true body made its move, the attacks from dozens of avatars completely shook the foundation of the grand palace and then compressed the layers of space-time.

In an instant.

The once grand palace began to shrink, falling into the palm of Lin Yuan's hand.

The grand palace, which was once a protective haven for numerous twelfth-tier alien species, had now become their prison.

"No."

"Why, why is the avatar of the Galaxy Master so strong?"

"Galaxy Master, we were wrong, we are willing to forever submit to human civilization, willing to hand over ninety percent of our twelfth-tier weapons, armaments, and treasures..."

Inside the grand palace, the ultimate beings of the twelfth tier panicked, as they were now completely suppressed within the palace, although there was no immediate issue.

But they had lost their freedom, their ability to act.

This was terrifying, as the Galaxy Master could easily think of ways to deal with them slowly.

Even if he was still unable to kill them, when the cosmic apocalypse arrived, he could simply throw the palace into the deepest reaches of the universe.

The might of the cosmic apocalypse was capable of passing through the palace and descending upon them, and at that time all the ultimate beings trapped in the palace could not move, only to endure wave after wave of destructive forces, with their downfall nearly inevitable.

"Only now you realize your mistake? Too late."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, as he had already given these twelfth-tier ultimate beings a chance before.

In fact, from the dormant era of human civilization during the ancient epochs to the over two million years of the Starry Sea Era before Lin Yuan became the supreme being.

Who knows how many evolutionaries have perished at the hands of these twelfth-tier ultimate beings.

Although the twelfth-tier ultimate beings were disdainful of taking action against the weak, the aftershocks of their battles could cause the collapse of tens or even scores of star domains.

"What?"

In the territory of the Robber Clan, the two ultimate beings of the clan were plunged into confusion, even for them, the formidable peak-defense secret treasure of the Path Splitting Realm seemed so easily suppressed by Lin Yuan?

"Galaxy Master..."

The two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan looked towards the slowly dissipating dozens of avatars, their minds somewhat trembling.

Dozens of avatars, each possessing nearly the peak combat power of the Path Splitting Realm? How could this be possible?

"Just avatars, and they have nearly the peak combat power of the Path Splitting Realm, then the real body of the Galaxy Master must at least possess the strength of the Sovereign Realm." The ultimate being of the Robber Clan on the right couldn't help gulping down his saliva as he gazed at the composed Lin Yuan.

Compared to the bewildered state of those suppressed twelfth-tier ultimate beings, these two could deduce much more.

First of all, it was certain that the combat power of the avatars was far below that of the real body. There was no doubt, for how could avatars, merely condensed from a wisp of mind will at whim, compare to the rigorously tempered physical body and soul of the real body?

The fact that Lin Yuan's dozens of avatars exhibited such terrifying strength indicated only one possibility: the combat power of his real body must be far greater than the peak of the Path Splitting Realm.

The current level of Lin Yuan's real body is only at the peak of the Path Splitting Realm because that is the upper limit of this universe.

"I'm leaving now."

Lin Yuan glanced at the two ultimate beings of the Robber Clan, who had fallen into silence, and his figure vanished.

"Galaxy Master... I now have no doubt that the Galaxy Master is the reincarnation of a Great Saint." The ultimate being of the Robber Clan on the left remarked with emotion.

Originally they thought that just stepping into the twelfth tier and reaching the peak of the Path Splitting Realm was the limit.

Who would have thought the Galaxy Master would soar directly to the Sovereign Realm? Even in the Chaos Void, the Sovereign Realm is considered strong, and unless one enters those dangerous and important places voluntarily, it's hard to perish completely.

And yet, the Galaxy Master reaches Sovereign Realm upon first entering the twelfth tier?

...

The news of Lin Yuan suppressing dozens of twelfth-tier ultimate beings spread quickly throughout the cosmic starry skies.

The eleventh-tier powerhouses from the peak clan forces, upon learning that their ancestors had fallen into the hands of the Galaxy Master, began to lose their composure.

"Our ancestor has been captured by the Galaxy Master?"

"But our ancestor is an ultimate being, how could it be so easy..."

"I don't believe it, I can't believe it."

...

One by one, the eleventh-tier powerhouses from the peak clans found it hard to believe, but soon they learned the truth of the matter from the avatars left within their clans by their own ancestors.

...

Rustle.

Lin Yuan put away the grand palace, took a step forward, and his figure once again descended upon the third strategic location of human civilization.

Xuanyuan Supreme and the other nine supreme beings had their minds turn into mush; just a moment ago they were discussing how to deal with the dozens of twelfth-tier alien species, thinking that a grueling battle was imminent, and it might last for a long time.

But before they even had a chance to go into details, the Galaxy Master had already dealt with all the twelfth-tier aliens?
